Title: The Clever Fox
Passage:
One sunny morning, a clever fox was walking through the forest. He looked up and saw a crow sitting on a tree branch with a piece of cheese in its beak. 

The fox wanted the cheese, so he thought of a clever plan. He smiled and said, 'Dear Crow, you have such beautiful feathers. I wonder if your singing is as lovely as your appearance. 

The crow felt proud and opened its beak to sing. As soon as it did, the cheese fell to the ground. The fox quickly picked it up and ran away. The crow realized it had been tricked and learned not to trust flattery.

Title: The Lost Puppy
Passage: A little puppy named Max wandered away from his home while chasing a butterfly. Soon he realized he was lost. Max felt scared and hungry, but he kept walking. \n\nA kind girl noticed the puppy and gave him some water. She looked at the tag on his collar and called the phone number. Max's owner arrived a short time later and thanked the girl for helping his puppy. Max was happy to be back home with his family.

Title: The Solar System
Passage: Our solar system consists of the Sun and eight planets that move around it. Mercury is the closest planet to the Sun, while Neptune is the farthest. Earth is the third planet and the only known planet that supports life. Each planet travels around the Sun in its own orbit. Scientists use telescopes and spacecraft to learn more about our solar system and the universe beyond.

Title: The First Airplane Flight
Passage: In 1903, Orville and Wilbur Wright made the first successful powered airplane flight in North Carolina, USA. Their airplane stayed in the air for only a short time, but it proved that powered flight was possible. Their invention changed transportation forever. Today, millions of people travel by airplane every day because of the Wright brothers' hard work and determination.

Title: Saving Water
Passage: Water is one of Earth's most valuable resources. We use it for drinking, cooking, farming, and cleaning. However, fresh water is limited, so everyone should use it wisely. Simple actions such as turning off the tap while brushing your teeth, fixing leaking pipes, and collecting rainwater can help save water. When people work together, they can protect this important resource for future generations.
